title: Simon 2.5 bound: |δV(Y)| ≤ sup|Y| · ‖δV‖(W) for test fields supported in W ⊂⊂ U
statement: Let V be an n-varifold on the open set U ⊆ ℝ^N with locally bounded first variation, let W ⊆ ℝ^N be open with closure W compact and closure W ⊆ U, let K ∈ ℝ, and let Y : ℝ^N → ℝ^N be a C¹ vector field with tsupport Y ⊆ W and |Y(z)| ≤ K for all z. Then |δV(Y)| ≤ K·‖δV‖(W), where δV(Y) = V.firstVariation Y and ‖δV‖ = variationMeasure V; in ℝ≥0∞: ofReal|δV(Y)| ≤ ofReal K · variationMeasure V W.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (W : Set (Euclidean N)) (Y : Euclidean N → Euclidean N) (K : ℝ), V.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → IsOpen W → IsCompact (closure W) → closure W ⊆ U → ContDiff ℝ 1 Y → tsupport Y ⊆ W → (∀ z, ‖Y z‖ ≤ K) → ENNReal.ofReal |V.firstVariation Y| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal K * variationMeasure V W
